scripts.test:learning-path: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec tsx --test ../../lib/api-client-react/tests/learning-path.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/ethio-hudhud run test:learning-path && pnpm run test:learning-path:api
